dialogues.jp: 俺と環は、今日も一緒に登校している。
dialogues.en:
Once again, Tamaki and I were meeting to walk to school
together.
dialogues.text:
Once again, Tamaki and I were meeting to walk to school
together.

dialogues.jp: 今日は、｛さすが／流石｝に遅れなかった。
dialogues.en: I almost thought I was late today.
dialogues.text: I almost thought I was late today.

dialogues.jp: と、いうか、時間ギリギリだ。
dialogues.en: In actual fact, I was just about on time,
dialogues.text: In actual fact, I was just about on time,

dialogues.jp:
だから、もちろん環の方が先に来て待っていた
のだが。
dialogues.en:
But of course, Tamaki was there waiting well ahead of
schedule.
dialogues.text:
But of course, Tamaki was there waiting well ahead of
schedule.

dialogues.jp:
いつも環が言う『わたくしも今来たところです
から』の言葉につい甘えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Although she'd always tell me "I just arrived", or something
similar to not make me feel bad.
dialogues.text:
Although she'd always tell me "I just arrived", or something
similar to not make me feel bad.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いな。なんかいつも待たせちゃって」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I made you wait again."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I made you wait again."

dialogues.jp:
悪いと思っていても、人間、癖はそう簡単には
直らない。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't be able to fix that habit easily, even if I meant
it.
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't be able to fix that habit easily, even if I meant
it.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいんです」
dialogues.en: "It's fine."
dialogues.text: "It's fine."

dialogues.jp: 環はニッコリ笑って微笑む。
dialogues.en: She showed off her winning smile.
dialogues.text: She showed off her winning smile.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺の顔をまっすぐ見つめる。
dialogues.en: Her eyes then moved to my face.
dialogues.text: Her eyes then moved to my face.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくしの方こそ、朝倉様に感謝しないと」
dialogues.en: "I have not thanked you yet, either."
dialogues.text: "I have not thanked you yet, either."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「感謝？」
dialogues.en: "Thanked me?"
dialogues.text: "Thanked me?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「だって」
環は赤面して、下を向く。
dialogues.en:
She bowed her head down slightly, her face growing noticably
red.
dialogues.text:
She bowed her head down slightly, her face growing noticably
red.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いつも早く起きて、一緒に学校へ行ってくれ
　るんですもの」
dialogues.en:
"After all, you're always waking up early so that we can go
to school together..."
dialogues.text:
"After all, you're always waking up early so that we can go
to school together..."

dialogues.jp:
環の声は、少し小さいが、俺の耳に届くには十
分だった。
dialogues.en: She said in a meek voice, but it was clear to my ears.
dialogues.text: She said in a meek voice, but it was clear to my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「早起き、大変でしょ？」
dialogues.en: "You don't normally wake up early, right?"
dialogues.text: "You don't normally wake up early, right?"

dialogues.jp: 環、気づいてくれてたんだ……。
dialogues.en: She's pretty perceptive...
dialogues.text: She's pretty perceptive...

dialogues.jp: 俺まで耳まで真っ赤になってしまう。
dialogues.en: The tip of my ears started to grow hot.
dialogues.text: The tip of my ears started to grow hot.

dialogues.jp: 今まで、
dialogues.en: She's that kind of person.
dialogues.text: She's that kind of person.

dialogues.jp: 『早く起きなさい』と言う人はいても、
dialogues.en:
Unlike certain people I know who would just tell me to hurry
up and get up,
dialogues.text:
Unlike certain people I know who would just tell me to hurry
up and get up,

dialogues.jp: 早く起きて感謝されたことなんてなかった。
dialogues.en: She thanks me for getting up early instead.
dialogues.text: She thanks me for getting up early instead.

dialogues.jp: なんか、環といると、本当に癒される。
dialogues.en: Thanks to Tamaki, I've somehow stopped being a latecomer.
dialogues.text: Thanks to Tamaki, I've somehow stopped being a latecomer.

dialogues.jp: 環は俺といて、どう思ってるんだろう。
dialogues.en: I wonder whether she's thought of it that way.
dialogues.text: I wonder whether she's thought of it that way.

dialogues.jp: 多少は癒されることもあるのだろうか？
dialogues.en: She's helping me out, after all.
dialogues.text: She's helping me out, after all.

dialogues.jp: 俺も、環の癒しになれるように頑張ろう。
dialogues.en: I have to learn to help her out too.
dialogues.text: I have to learn to help her out too.

dialogues.jp: 「環、ありがとな」
dialogues.en: "Thanks, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Thanks, Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ボソッとつぶやくように言う。
dialogues.en: I said softly.
dialogues.text: I said softly.

dialogues.jp: 環は不思議そうに首をかしげている。
dialogues.en: She stared at me, confused.
dialogues.text: She stared at me, confused.

dialogues.jp: 今度は、環の耳に届くように言う。
dialogues.en: This time, just barely audible,
dialogues.text: This time, just barely audible,

dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう……」
dialogues.en: "Thank you..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、無言で頷く。
dialogues.en: She wordlessly nodded.
dialogues.text: She wordlessly nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、行きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go?"

dialogues.jp: 俺達が校門の中に入ろうとすると、
dialogues.en: We entered the school compound, and immediately,
dialogues.text: We entered the school compound, and immediately,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃ〜ん♪」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan~"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan~"

dialogues.jp: 元気な声と共にさくらがやってくる。
dialogues.en: Sakura appeared as I heard her cheerful voice cry out.
dialogues.text: Sakura appeared as I heard her cheerful voice cry out.

dialogues.jp: さくらは、なぜか──制服は着ていなかった。
dialogues.en: For some reason, Sakura wasn't wearing the school uniform...
dialogues.text: For some reason, Sakura wasn't wearing the school uniform...

dialogues.jp: 「あ、さくら」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Sakura."

dialogues.jp: 久しぶりに、さくらの声を聞く。
dialogues.en: It's been a while since I heard the sound of her voice.
dialogues.text: It's been a while since I heard the sound of her voice.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、何処行ってたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "When did you get here?"
dialogues.text: "When did you get here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「へへへ。ちょっとね」
dialogues.en: "Hehehe, just a bit ago."
dialogues.text: "Hehehe, just a bit ago."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前、入学式にもこなかっただろ」
dialogues.en: "You never went for the opening ceremony either."
dialogues.text: "You never went for the opening ceremony either."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん。ボクは進学しないからね」
dialogues.en: "Yep, I'm going to college after all."
dialogues.text: "Yep, I'm going to college after all."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 進学しない？
dialogues.en: Going to college?
dialogues.text: Going to college?

dialogues.jp: じゃ、どうしてここにいるんだよ。
dialogues.en: Then what's she doing here?
dialogues.text: Then what's she doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「環ちゃん、こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Hi Tamaki-chan!"
dialogues.text: "Hi Tamaki-chan!"

dialogues.jp: さくらは、俺の疑問は無視し環に声を掛ける。
dialogues.en:
Completely disregarding my confusion, Sakura greeted Tamaki
brightly.
dialogues.text:
Completely disregarding my confusion, Sakura greeted Tamaki
brightly.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「さくら様。お久しぶりですね」
dialogues.en: "It has been awhile, Sakura-san."
dialogues.text: "It has been awhile, Sakura-san."

dialogues.jp: 環はさくらに微笑みかける。
dialogues.en: Tamaki gave her a warm smile.
dialogues.text: Tamaki gave her a warm smile.

dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、この二人は、意外に仲が良かった
んだった。何度か一緒にいるところを見たよう
な気がする。
dialogues.en:
Those two have been uenxpectedly close... I've seen them
together quite a few times.
dialogues.text:
Those two have been uenxpectedly close... I've seen them
together quite a few times.

dialogues.jp:
やはり、不思議な力を持つもの同士、共鳴する
部分があるのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Perhaps those with strange powers resonate among each other
and find solace in each other.
dialogues.text:
Perhaps those with strange powers resonate among each other
and find solace in each other.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「へえ、そっか」
dialogues.en: "He-eh, I see."
dialogues.text: "He-eh, I see."

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、口に手を当てながら、何か考えてい
る。
dialogues.en:
Sakura had put her fingers to her chin, thinking about
something.
dialogues.text:
Sakura had put her fingers to her chin, thinking about
something.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ふーん」
dialogues.en: "Hmm."
dialogues.text: "Hmm."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「言いたいことがあるなら言えよ」
dialogues.en: "If you've got something to say, say it."
dialogues.text: "If you've got something to say, say it."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「二人とも、付き合ってるんだ」
dialogues.en: "You two are dating, huh?"
dialogues.text: "You two are dating, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Ehh!?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh!?"

dialogues.jp: 核心を突くさくらの発言に驚く。
dialogues.en: From out of nothing, shes truck at my core.
dialogues.text: From out of nothing, shes truck at my core.

dialogues.jp: ど、どうしてわかるんだ？
dialogues.en: H, how did she know that?
dialogues.text: H, how did she know that?

dialogues.jp: 俺、さくらには何も言ってないはずだけど……。
dialogues.en: I never told her anything...
dialogues.text: I never told her anything...

dialogues.jp: さくらは悪戯っぽく笑い、
dialogues.en: A mischevious little grin played on her lips.
dialogues.text: A mischevious little grin played on her lips.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「だって、ほら」
dialogues.en: "Look at that after all."
dialogues.text: "Look at that after all."

dialogues.jp: 俺の鞄についているお守りを指差す。
dialogues.en: She pointed at the charm hanging from my bag.
dialogues.text: She pointed at the charm hanging from my bag.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「これ、おそろいでしょ？」
dialogues.en: "Doesn't that make it obvious?"
dialogues.text: "Doesn't that make it obvious?"

dialogues.jp: あっ、そうか。
dialogues.en: Oh... right.
dialogues.text: Oh... right.

dialogues.jp: お守りつけてれば、そりゃ、わかるよな。
dialogues.en:
And with her Miko fetish, she probably knows a lot about
those things.
dialogues.text:
And with her Miko fetish, she probably knows a lot about
those things.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ちぇっ。昔はお兄ちゃんはボクのものだった
　のにな……」
dialogues.en:
"Pah. Onii-chan used to be mine and mine alone, way back
when..."
dialogues.text:
"Pah. Onii-chan used to be mine and mine alone, way back
when..."

dialogues.jp: 一体、いつそんな話があったんだ？
dialogues.en: Now what's she talking about?
dialogues.text: Now what's she talking about?

dialogues.jp: と、問い詰めたい。
dialogues.en: She went on, as if answering my question,
dialogues.text: She went on, as if answering my question,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あーあ。いいな。環ちゃん。ボク、やきもち
　妬いちゃうよ」
dialogues.en:
"Ah-ah, you're so lucky, Tamaki-chan. I'm getting jealous
already!"
dialogues.text:
"Ah-ah, you're so lucky, Tamaki-chan. I'm getting jealous
already!"

dialogues.jp:
環は少し、暗い顔をして俯く。別に、さくらに
気を使うこと無いのに。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki's face darkened slightly. That Sakura really has no
tact whatsoever.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki's face darkened slightly. That Sakura really has no
tact whatsoever.

dialogues.jp: 俺だって、環のことを好きになったんだから。
dialogues.en: I'm the one who chose her, because I liked her.
dialogues.text: I'm the one who chose her, because I liked her.

dialogues.jp: と、言ってやりたくなる。
dialogues.en: I opened my mouth to reprimand her,
dialogues.text: I opened my mouth to reprimand her,

dialogues.jp: しかし、さくらはニッコリと笑って、
dialogues.en: But before I could, Sakura was already happily replying.
dialogues.text: But before I could, Sakura was already happily replying.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でも、環ちゃんで安心したよ。二人はお似合
　いだね♪」
dialogues.en:
"But, you don't have to worry, Tamaki-chan. You two look
good together~"
dialogues.text:
"But, you don't have to worry, Tamaki-chan. You two look
good together~"

dialogues.jp: と、環と俺を交互に見る。
dialogues.en: She looked at both of us as she said that.
dialogues.text: She looked at both of us as she said that.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の方を見る。
dialogues.en: Myself, I glanced at Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Myself, I glanced at Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 環は、それを聞いて正直、安心したようだった。
dialogues.en: At hearing such honesty, she seemed relieved.
dialogues.text: At hearing such honesty, she seemed relieved.

dialogues.jp: 「あたりまえだろ」
dialogues.en: "Of course we do."
dialogues.text: "Of course we do."

dialogues.jp: 俺は照れ隠しに、ぶっきらぼうに言う。
dialogues.en: I spitted out, hiding my own embarassment.
dialogues.text: I spitted out, hiding my own embarassment.

dialogues.jp:
誰かに二人の間を認めてもらうのって、やっぱ
り嬉しいよな。
dialogues.en:
Having someone to compliment our relationship made me happy
though.
dialogues.text:
Having someone to compliment our relationship made me happy
though.

dialogues.jp:
自分達だけでいい、と思っていても、多くの人
に認めてもらえれば、そっちの方が嬉しいに決
まってる。
dialogues.en:
All we really need is ourselves, but if other people think
it's good too, of course we'd be happy.
dialogues.text:
All we really need is ourselves, but if other people think
it's good too, of course we'd be happy.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「環ちゃん、また神社に遊びに行ってもいい？」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki-chan, can I still visit the shrine?"
dialogues.text: "Tamaki-chan, can I still visit the shrine?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。いつでもどうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Of course. You are welcome anytime."
dialogues.text: "Of course. You are welcome anytime."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やった。ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Yay, thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Yay, thank you!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、ボクはもう行くね」
dialogues.en: "I'd be going now, then!"
dialogues.text: "I'd be going now, then!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ばいばーい」
dialogues.en: "Bye byeeee!"
dialogues.text: "Bye byeeee!"

dialogues.jp:
さくらは俺達に手を振って、桜並木へと去って
いった。
dialogues.en: Sakura waved at us, then dashed down the Sakura Avenue.
dialogues.text: Sakura waved at us, then dashed down the Sakura Avenue.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、さくらさんって、素敵な方ですね」
dialogues.en: "Sakura-san is so wonderful."
dialogues.text: "Sakura-san is so wonderful."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Uh, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, yeah..."

dialogues.jp: さくらの後姿が小さくなって、
dialogues.en: As Sakura's figure disappeared into the horizon,
dialogues.text: As Sakura's figure disappeared into the horizon,

dialogues.jp: 俺達は学校へと入っていった。
dialogues.en: We turned around and entered school.
dialogues.text: We turned around and entered school.

dialogues.jp: 休み時間になり、俺は環のいる教室へ足を運ぶ。
dialogues.en: Once break time came, I headed for Tamaki's classroom.
dialogues.text: Once break time came, I headed for Tamaki's classroom.

dialogues.jp:
何と言っても、今日は環が手作りのお弁当を食
べさせてくれるって話だからな。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki had mentioned today that she wanted me to taste her
lunchbox.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki had mentioned today that she wanted me to taste her
lunchbox.

dialogues.jp: 不思議と、足がスキップになってしまう。
dialogues.en: That was enough to put a skip in my step.
dialogues.text: That was enough to put a skip in my step.

dialogues.jp: 食べるなら、やっぱり天気がいいから中庭かな？
dialogues.en:
If it's having a meal, as long as the weather's good, the
courtyard should be an awesome atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
If it's having a meal, as long as the weather's good, the
courtyard should be an awesome atmosphere.

dialogues.jp: それとも、屋上にするか……。
dialogues.en: The rooftop would be a good comeptitor though...
dialogues.text: The rooftop would be a good comeptitor though...

dialogues.jp: 中身は何だろう？
dialogues.en: I wonder what she prepared?
dialogues.text: I wonder what she prepared?

dialogues.jp:
前の時間から、楽しみで仕方がなく、授業はほ
とんど聞いていない。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to salivating over the future feast, I couldn't
concentrate on the lesson earlier at all.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to salivating over the future feast, I couldn't
concentrate on the lesson earlier at all.

dialogues.jp:
ま、いつも聞いているのかとつっこまれると、
甚だ疑問ではあるが……。
dialogues.en: Not that that's anything new to us anyway...
dialogues.text: Not that that's anything new to us anyway...

dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の名前を呼ぶ。
dialogues.en: I called out her name.
dialogues.text: I called out her name.

dialogues.jp: 環の席を見ると、何やら人だかりができている。
dialogues.en:
But as I looked towards her desk, there was a crowd of
people blocking out my voice.
dialogues.text:
But as I looked towards her desk, there was a crowd of
people blocking out my voice.

dialogues.jp: 環を囲んで、話をしているようだ。
dialogues.en: They were all surrounding Tamaki, chattering.
dialogues.text: They were all surrounding Tamaki, chattering.

dialogues.jp: 一体、何なんだ？
dialogues.en: What's... going on?
dialogues.text: What's... going on?

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の席に近づいていく。
dialogues.en: I got closer to Tamaki's desk.
dialogues.text: I got closer to Tamaki's desk.

dialogues.jp: すると、
dialogues.en: Only to hear,
dialogues.text: Only to hear,

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、胡ノ宮さん。私の未来も見てよ」
dialogues.en: "Konomiya-san, Konomiya-san! Tell me my future too!"
dialogues.text: "Konomiya-san, Konomiya-san! Tell me my future too!"

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 2
dialogues.jp:
「すごいわね。どうしてそんな能力、目覚めた
　の？」
dialogues.en: "That's amazing... how did you get such an ability?"
dialogues.text: "That's amazing... how did you get such an ability?"

dialogues.jp: 環の周りの女の子達は、
dialogues.en: Those girls surrounding Tamaki...
dialogues.text: Those girls surrounding Tamaki...

dialogues.jp:
やはり環の予知能力が気になるらしく、噂を聞
きつけ環に問い詰めているらしかった。
dialogues.en:
They'd found out about Tamaki's power, apparently... and
were bombarding Tamaki with questions and requests.
dialogues.text:
They'd found out about Tamaki's power, apparently... and
were bombarding Tamaki with questions and requests.

dialogues.jp: 環は、苦笑いしながらも受け答えている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki just seemed to take it all with a tired smile.
dialogues.text: Tamaki just seemed to take it all with a tired smile.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「さあ、ある日突然だったから、わたくしにも
　よくわからなくて……」
dialogues.en:
"I don't know... I had just suddenly realized I possessed
it..."
dialogues.text:
"I don't know... I had just suddenly realized I possessed
it..."

dialogues.speaker: Female Student 3
dialogues.jp: 「いいなあ。私も予知能力が欲しい」
dialogues.en: "That's amazing. I wish I had a power like that."
dialogues.text: "That's amazing. I wish I had a power like that."

dialogues.jp: と、言う一言に、皆、賛同している。
dialogues.en: One after another, the exclamations and questions came.
dialogues.text: One after another, the exclamations and questions came.

dialogues.jp: ったく、人の苦労もしらないで……。
dialogues.en: Bah, they can only see the silver lining...
dialogues.text: Bah, they can only see the silver lining...

dialogues.jp:
環と同じような体験をしても、まだそう言って
られるのか聞いてやりたい。
dialogues.en:
I'd bet she'd take back her words on the spot, once she's
gone through what Tamaki has.
dialogues.text:
I'd bet she'd take back her words on the spot, once she's
gone through what Tamaki has.

dialogues.jp: 人に無責任に期待され、裏切られ、｛ほんろう／翻弄｝される。
dialogues.en:
People are irresponsible. They have unreasonable
expectations, betray others, make fun of those different
from them.
dialogues.text:
People are irresponsible. They have unreasonable
expectations, betray others, make fun of those different
from them.

dialogues.jp:
本人の意志とは関係なく、他人の未来が見えて
しまう。
dialogues.en:
Who cares about the person doing them the service. All they
want is to have their future foreseen.
dialogues.text:
Who cares about the person doing them the service. All they
want is to have their future foreseen.

dialogues.jp: そんな責任の重みに、耐えられるのか？
dialogues.en: Would they want to bear such a heavy burden?
dialogues.text: Would they want to bear such a heavy burden?

dialogues.jp:
それでも、環みたいに、いつも、笑っていられ
るのかよ。
dialogues.en:
Furthermore, just like her, she kept smiling through the
ordeal.
dialogues.text:
Furthermore, just like her, she kept smiling through the
ordeal.

dialogues.jp: 環も環だ。
dialogues.en: Just like herself...
dialogues.text: Just like herself...

dialogues.jp: こんなやつら、放っておけばいい。
dialogues.en: She should just get away from those poeple.
dialogues.text: She should just get away from those poeple.

dialogues.jp: 無理することなんてない。
dialogues.en: She doesn't have to go through this crap.
dialogues.text: She doesn't have to go through this crap.

dialogues.jp:
俺がふてくされて環を見ていると、環がそれに
気づいたのか、申し訳なさそうな顔をしてくる。
dialogues.en:
I continued sulking to myself. Tamaki seemingly noticed me,
with a distressed look on her face.
dialogues.text:
I continued sulking to myself. Tamaki seemingly noticed me,
with a distressed look on her face.

dialogues.jp:
お昼の約束を果たせないから、怒ってるわけじゃ
ない。
dialogues.en:
It's not like I'd be angry if the promise we made was
broken.
dialogues.text:
It's not like I'd be angry if the promise we made was
broken.

dialogues.jp: ま、それも少しあるけど……。
dialogues.en: Well, I guess I would be a little, but still...
dialogues.text: Well, I guess I would be a little, but still...

dialogues.jp:
こいつらが邪魔しなければ、俺達は普通に飯が
食えるのに。
dialogues.en:
These people are getting in the way of a normal and pleasant
lunch.
dialogues.text:
These people are getting in the way of a normal and pleasant
lunch.

dialogues.jp:
さて、そろそろ環を連れ出さないと、昼休みが
終わってしまう。
dialogues.en: And if she doesn't escape soon, lunch break's gonna be over.
dialogues.text: And if she doesn't escape soon, lunch break's gonna be over.

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 1
dialogues.jp: 「おい、あれか？　予知能力少女って」
dialogues.en: "Oh? It's the Prophet Girl."
dialogues.text: "Oh? It's the Prophet Girl."

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 2
dialogues.jp: 「結構、可愛い顔してんじゃん」
dialogues.en: "She's pretty cute, ain't she?"
dialogues.text: "She's pretty cute, ain't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Male Student 3
dialogues.jp: 「俺も未来を占って欲しいよな」
dialogues.en: "Maybe she'd tell me my future..."
dialogues.text: "Maybe she'd tell me my future..."

dialogues.jp:
ふと見ると、廊下側の窓から、他のクラスらし
い男子学生が覗いている。
dialogues.en:
The murmurs alerted me to a group of students, presumably
from another class, staring at her through the window.
dialogues.text:
The murmurs alerted me to a group of students, presumably
from another class, staring at her through the window.

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わずムッとする。
dialogues.en: I instinctively reacted.
dialogues.text: I instinctively reacted.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、見世物じゃねえぞ！」
dialogues.en: "Hey! Don't talk as if she's some exhibit on show!"
dialogues.text: "Hey! Don't talk as if she's some exhibit on show!"

dialogues.jp: おそらく、俺の剣幕がすごかったのだろう。
dialogues.en: I might've been a bit too threatening there...
dialogues.text: I might've been a bit too threatening there...

dialogues.jp: 男子学生たちは、驚いて廊下を走っていった。
dialogues.en: Considering the speed at which they ran away.
dialogues.text: Considering the speed at which they ran away.

dialogues.jp: 「ったく」
dialogues.en: "Bahhh."
dialogues.text: "Bahhh."

dialogues.jp: 俺はふと教室へ目を移す。
dialogues.en: Having taken my eyes off the classroom for a moment,
dialogues.text: Having taken my eyes off the classroom for a moment,

dialogues.jp: すると、１年１組の人たちからも見られていた。
dialogues.en: Some people from class 1 had come to sightsee too.
dialogues.text: Some people from class 1 had come to sightsee too.

dialogues.jp: 彼らから見れば、俺の方がよそ者だな。
dialogues.en: I stared at them, and they stared right back.
dialogues.text: I stared at them, and they stared right back.

dialogues.jp: 人の教室来て、何を怒鳴ってるんだって……。
dialogues.en: How am I going to extract her from this mess...
dialogues.text: How am I going to extract her from this mess...

dialogues.jp: 俺はポリポリと頭をかく。
dialogues.en: I wracked my brain for a solution.
dialogues.text: I wracked my brain for a solution.

dialogues.jp: 何と言うべきか。
dialogues.en: What can I say to dissuade them...
dialogues.text: What can I say to dissuade them...

dialogues.jp: しかし、ここで『すいません』もなんだし。
dialogues.en: I don't think "Excuse me" would really work here.
dialogues.text: I don't think "Excuse me" would really work here.

dialogues.jp: 環は、そんな俺の様子を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki though, taking a quick glance at me, spoke.
dialogues.text: Tamaki though, taking a quick glance at me, spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい。約束してるの忘れてました」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry... I have a promise I need to fulfill."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry... I have a promise I need to fulfill."

dialogues.jp: 環は、すっと席を立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki finally stood up from her desk.
dialogues.text: Tamaki finally stood up from her desk.

dialogues.jp: 約束？
dialogues.en: A promise?
dialogues.text: A promise?

dialogues.jp: ひょっとして、俺に気を使ってくれたのかな。
dialogues.en: Did she notice me?
dialogues.text: Did she notice me?

dialogues.jp: 環は俺がいる方へと歩み寄る。
dialogues.en: She then started walking in my direction.
dialogues.text: She then started walking in my direction.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ご飯、一緒に食べるんでしたよね」
dialogues.en: "Shall we have lunch together?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we have lunch together?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え、あ、ああ……」
dialogues.en: "Eh, a, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "Eh, a, ahh..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「すみません。また後で必ず見ますから……」
dialogues.en: "My apologies... I will see you all again, certainly..."
dialogues.text: "My apologies... I will see you all again, certainly..."

dialogues.jp: 環はクラスメートに向かって、約束をする。
dialogues.en: Tamaki made a promise herself, to her classmates.
dialogues.text: Tamaki made a promise herself, to her classmates.

dialogues.jp: そして俺の腕を引っ張り、教室を出る。
dialogues.en: Then, pulling on my arm, she led me out of the classroom.
dialogues.text: Then, pulling on my arm, she led me out of the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「いいのか？　あんな約束して……」
dialogues.en: "Was making that promise really the right thing to do...?"
dialogues.text: "Was making that promise really the right thing to do...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。大丈夫です」
dialogues.en: "Yes... It'd be fine."
dialogues.text: "Yes... It'd be fine."

dialogues.jp: 環はにっこりと笑って答える。
dialogues.en: She smiled at me as she answered.
dialogues.text: She smiled at me as she answered.

dialogues.jp: 予知するのは、好きじゃなかったんじゃ……。
dialogues.en:
But she's told me before that she doesn't like seeing
people's futures...
dialogues.text:
But she's told me before that she doesn't like seeing
people's futures...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、何となく心の中で、明るい環がひっかか
る。
dialogues.en:
Despite how bright her behaviour was, my heart wasn't
convinced so easily.
dialogues.text:
Despite how bright her behaviour was, my heart wasn't
convinced so easily.

dialogues.jp:
今までだって、予知をしてきて、辛いこともた
くさんあったはずなのに。
dialogues.en:
Even now, whenever she uses her power, awful things happen
to her...
dialogues.text:
Even now, whenever she uses her power, awful things happen
to her...

dialogues.jp: 環は、本当に辛くないのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Is she really okay with doing that?
dialogues.text: Is she really okay with doing that?

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとして、無理をしているのではないかと
思えてしまう。
dialogues.en: Maybe since it isn't a huge issue yet...
dialogues.text: Maybe since it isn't a huge issue yet...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「さあ、朝倉様、行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama, shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama, shall we go?"

dialogues.jp: 環は俺はぐいぐい引っ張る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki tugged on my shoulder again.
dialogues.text: Tamaki tugged on my shoulder again.

dialogues.jp: こんな積極的な環も珍しい。
dialogues.en: She's not usually this proactive...
dialogues.text: She's not usually this proactive...

dialogues.jp: 確かに腑に落ちないけど。
dialogues.en: She's a tough one to figure out.
dialogues.text: She's a tough one to figure out.

dialogues.jp:
これって、俺との時間を、大切に思ってくれて
るってことだよな。
dialogues.en: But she thinks so much of her time with me...
dialogues.text: But she thinks so much of her time with me...

dialogues.jp: それって、うれしい。
dialogues.en: That makes me glad.
dialogues.text: That makes me glad.

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は、弁当を広げる。
dialogues.en: We spread out her lunch together.
dialogues.text: We spread out her lunch together.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ〜ん。今日は肉じゃがです」
dialogues.en: "Ta-dah~! It's meat and potato stew today."
dialogues.text: "Ta-dah~! It's meat and potato stew today."

dialogues.jp: 環は、お重の中に肉じゃがを入れてきている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki then opened it up in one fell swoop.
dialogues.text: Tamaki then opened it up in one fell swoop.

dialogues.jp: 「おお！」
dialogues.en: "Ohhh!"
dialogues.text: "Ohhh!"

dialogues.jp: 俺はお弁当の豪華さに、思わず感嘆をもらす。
dialogues.en:
Feelings of wonder grew inside me as I stared at the
glorious food before me.
dialogues.text:
Feelings of wonder grew inside me as I stared at the
glorious food before me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「たくさん食べてくださいね」
dialogues.en: "Please eat as much as you can."
dialogues.text: "Please eat as much as you can."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いただきます！！」
dialogues.en: "I most certainly will!!"
dialogues.text: "I most certainly will!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ジャガイモを口に入れる。
dialogues.en: I instantly lifted a piece of potato to my mouth.
dialogues.text: I instantly lifted a piece of potato to my mouth.

dialogues.jp: あ〜。幸せ。
dialogues.en: Ahhh~, true happiness.
dialogues.text: Ahhh~, true happiness.

dialogues.jp: うまい。
dialogues.en: So delicious.
dialogues.text: So delicious.

dialogues.jp:
前にチョコレートを食べたときは、どうしよう
かと思ったが、普通の和食ならおいしく作れる
んだな。
dialogues.en:
Compared to the chocolate she made before, this was a much
more appetizing, Japanese-style meal.
dialogues.text:
Compared to the chocolate she made before, this was a much
more appetizing, Japanese-style meal.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……どうですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Is it good?"
dialogues.text: "...Is it good?"

dialogues.jp: 環は自分が箸をつける前に、上目遣いで尋ねる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki, still holding her chopsticks, looked upwards at me
with her head tilted down.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki, still holding her chopsticks, looked upwards at me
with her head tilted down.

dialogues.jp: 「もう、最高」
dialogues.en: "Good? I'm in heaven."
dialogues.text: "Good? I'm in heaven."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、他に言葉が見つからないぐらいの、幸せ
に浸っている。
dialogues.en:
There were no better words to display the joy that was
flowing out, and into me.
dialogues.text:
There were no better words to display the joy that was
flowing out, and into me.

dialogues.jp:
好きな子の手料理が食べられるだけで、幸せな
のに、その料理がおいしいなんて……。
dialogues.en:
Eating something the girl you love made for you, and having
it taste wonderful at the same time....
dialogues.text:
Eating something the girl you love made for you, and having
it taste wonderful at the same time....

dialogues.jp: これを至福と呼ばず、何と言おう！
dialogues.en: I'd say it as many times as I can, this is heaven!
dialogues.text: I'd say it as many times as I can, this is heaven!

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "That's good..."
dialogues.text: "That's good..."

dialogues.jp: 環も、やっと食べ始める。
dialogues.en: Tamaki finally started eating as well.
dialogues.text: Tamaki finally started eating as well.

dialogues.jp:
こんな普通のひと時を、幸せに感じられるなん
て。
dialogues.en:
Even such a simple thing, and time like this, made me feel
blissful.
dialogues.text:
Even such a simple thing, and time like this, made me feel
blissful.

dialogues.jp: 俺は何て、贅沢者なんだろう。
dialogues.en: I'm really such a lucky guy.
dialogues.text: I'm really such a lucky guy.

dialogues.jp:
でも、こうして幸せをかみ締めていても、何と
なく心にひっかかる。
dialogues.en:
Yet, the thought of giving this happiness up in the name of
God constantly ran through my mind.
dialogues.text:
Yet, the thought of giving this happiness up in the name of
God constantly ran through my mind.

dialogues.jp:
環の予知能力が、変な風に利用されなければい
いけど……。
dialogues.en:
I don't want her foreseeing powers to be used for weird
purposes, yet...
dialogues.text:
I don't want her foreseeing powers to be used for weird
purposes, yet...

dialogues.jp: 俺、考えすぎなのかな……。
dialogues.en: Meh, I'm thinking too much...
dialogues.text: Meh, I'm thinking too much...

dialogues.jp:
ここは、弁当を食べることに集中しなければ、
せっかく作ってくれた環に悪いだろう。
dialogues.en:
I should concentrate on this lunch. She took so much pains
to make it for me, I should be appreciating it more.
dialogues.text:
I should concentrate on this lunch. She took so much pains
to make it for me, I should be appreciating it more.

dialogues.jp: うん、そうだな。
dialogues.en: Yeah... that's right.
dialogues.text: Yeah... that's right.

dialogues.jp:
俺は不安を打ち消すように、腹いっぱい、環の
食事を堪能した。
dialogues.en:
Throwing off all my negativity and worries, I filled my
stomach with Tamaki's delicious food.
dialogues.text:
Throwing off all my negativity and worries, I filled my
stomach with Tamaki's delicious food.

dialogues.jp: 教室へ戻ると、杉並がやってきた。
dialogues.en: Back at classroom, Suginami was waiting.
dialogues.text: Back at classroom, Suginami was waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうだ？　アツアツ新婚生活は？」
dialogues.en: "So, how's the love-love newlywed life?"
dialogues.text: "So, how's the love-love newlywed life?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うるさいな、新婚なんかじゃないっての」
dialogues.en: "Shut up, we're not newlyweds."
dialogues.text: "Shut up, we're not newlyweds."

dialogues.jp: しかし……。
dialogues.en: Although I said that...
dialogues.text: Although I said that...

dialogues.jp: 自然と顔がほころぶのは何故だろう。
dialogues.en: My face still instantly flushed red.
dialogues.text: My face still instantly flushed red.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「胡ノ宮嬢の人気っぷりはどうだ？　最近、白
　河ことりと競るようだが」
dialogues.en:
"Konomiya has been popular lately, huh? She could even be
competing on Shirakawa's level."
dialogues.text:
"Konomiya has been popular lately, huh? She could even be
competing on Shirakawa's level."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: げ！
dialogues.en: Gah!
dialogues.text: Gah!

dialogues.jp: 知らなかった。そうなのか？
dialogues.en: I never really noticed.
dialogues.text: I never really noticed.

dialogues.jp: ……でも、それって……。
dialogues.en: ...But if that's so...
dialogues.text: ...But if that's so...

dialogues.jp: 環の人気を、素直に喜べない自分がいる。
dialogues.en:
If I were to be honest, the more popular she gets, the more
unhappy I get.
dialogues.text:
If I were to be honest, the more popular she gets, the more
unhappy I get.

dialogues.jp: 「だけど、予知能力が目当てだろ」
dialogues.en: "Because everyone wants to use her powers..."
dialogues.text: "Because everyone wants to use her powers..."

dialogues.jp:
半分、当たって欲しくないと思いながら、吐き
捨てるように俺は言う。
dialogues.en: At least, that was half the reason anyway.
dialogues.text: At least, that was half the reason anyway.

dialogues.jp: どいつもこいつも、本当の環を見ようとしない。
dialogues.en: I also didn't want people staring at her beauty...
dialogues.text: I also didn't want people staring at her beauty...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあな。悲しい人間の性だな」
dialogues.en: "Indeed. Such a pitiful life."
dialogues.text: "Indeed. Such a pitiful life."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり。
dialogues.en: Of course.
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.jp: 「まったく、アホくさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm surrounded by fools."
dialogues.text: "I'm surrounded by fools."

dialogues.jp: 未来が見たい、って言うやつらの気がしれない。
dialogues.en:
Fools who only want what they want, without caring how they
get it.
dialogues.text:
Fools who only want what they want, without caring how they
get it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そんなこと言わず、お前も見てもらったらど
　うなんだ？　気になるだろ？　自分の未来」
dialogues.en: "Speaking of that, has she foretold your own future yet?"
dialogues.text: "Speaking of that, has she foretold your own future yet?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺も胡ノ宮嬢に占ってもらおうかと……」
dialogues.en: "I have half a mind to ask her to see my future too..."
dialogues.text: "I have half a mind to ask her to see my future too..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「杉並、お前まで！　環は、占い師じゃないん
　だぞ！」
dialogues.en:
"...Why you, Suginami! Tamaki isn't just some
fortune-teller!"
dialogues.text:
"...Why you, Suginami! Tamaki isn't just some
fortune-teller!"

dialogues.jp: 思わず、声を荒げてしまう。
dialogues.en:
My voice raised and cried out, before I even thought about
it.
dialogues.text:
My voice raised and cried out, before I even thought about
it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほお。お前、結構マジなんだな」
dialogues.en: "Hm. You really are serious."
dialogues.text: "Hm. You really are serious."

dialogues.jp: 杉並は、まるで俺の心を見透かすように言う。
dialogues.en: Suginami said, as if he was seeing right through me.
dialogues.text: Suginami said, as if he was seeing right through me.

dialogues.jp: そういう問題じゃない。
dialogues.en: That isn't the problem.
dialogues.text: That isn't the problem.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、環を見せ物扱いするのはやめて欲しいだ
けだ……。
dialogues.en:
I just want to stop others from treating Tamaki like some
magic pair of spectacles on exhibit...
dialogues.text:
I just want to stop others from treating Tamaki like some
magic pair of spectacles on exhibit...

dialogues.jp: それだけだ。
dialogues.en: That's all I want.
dialogues.text: That's all I want.

dialogues.jp: ◆見世物は……◆
dialogues.en: ?◆Exhibit A is...?◆
dialogues.text: ?◆Exhibit A is...?◆

dialogues.jp:
環とは、いつも一緒に登校するのが習慣となっ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki and I eventually got into the pattern of walking to
school together.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki and I eventually got into the pattern of walking to
school together.

dialogues.jp:
昼休みになり、環の教室へ行くと、周りに人だ
かりができている。
dialogues.en:
At break time, when I went to her classroom, she was
surrounded by students.
dialogues.text:
At break time, when I went to her classroom, she was
surrounded by students.

dialogues.jp:
見ると、皆、環の予知能力が気になるらしく、
見て欲しいと迫っている。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, everyone had found out about Tamaki's
clairvoyance, and wanted her to see their futures.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, everyone had found out about Tamaki's
clairvoyance, and wanted her to see their futures.

dialogues.jp: まったく、見世物じゃねえぞ。
dialogues.en: Sheesh, she's not some exhibit.
dialogues.text: Sheesh, she's not some exhibit.
